calendarFaqs.q: When do HCPSS K–12 students start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: HCPSS students in grades K–12 start school on Monday, August 24, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Pre-K and RECC students start?
calendarFaqs.a: Pre-K and RECC students start on Thursday, August 27, 2026, three days after the K–12 opening day.

calendarFaqs.q: Which HCPSS dates have three-hour early closings?
calendarFaqs.a: HCPSS has three-hour early closings scheduled for September 30, November 23–24, December 9, February 11–12, April 8, May 17, June 2, June 7, and June 8. The February dates apply only to elementary schools, and other conference dates vary by school level.

calendarFaqs.q: Can the last day of school change because of weather closures?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. June 8 is the scheduled last student day, but HCPSS lists June 9–11 and June 14–16, 2027, as possible inclement weather make-up days.

calendarFaqs.q: How can I add HCPSS dates to my calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the .ics download on this page to import the listed dates into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. It is a one-time import and will not automatically update if HCPSS revises the calendar.

customSections.label: Important HCPSS Calendar Notes
customSections.content: These are the HCPSS calendar details families are most likely to miss when comparing the online calendar, the printable PDF, and school-level schedules.

groups.label: K–12 and Pre-K/RECC students start on different days
items: Students in grades K–12 begin August 24, while Pre-K and RECC students begin August 27.
Families with younger children should use the Pre-K/RECC date when arranging transportation and child care.

groups.label: Watch for three-hour early closings
items: HCPSS schedules several days when schools close three hours early.
Half-day Pre-K/RECC does not meet on those dates, and some conference schedules vary by grade level.

groups.label: The last day may change
items: June 8 is the scheduled last day.
If emergency closures occur during the year, HCPSS may use designated June dates as student attendance days.

customSections.label: Calendar Revision Note
customSections.content: HCPSS’s current online dates-only calendar differs from the September 2025 PDF. The online calendar lists elementary conference early closings on February 11–12, 2027, and identifies June 9–11 and June 14–16 as possible inclement weather make-up days. This page follows the current online calendar.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2025–26
content: K–12 students start on August 24, 2026, one calendar day earlier than the 2025–26 K–12 opening day.
Pre-K/RECC students again start after K–12 students, so families with younger students should use the separate August 27 opening date.
The current online calendar adds elementary conference early closings on February 11–12, 2027, which were not reflected in the September 2025 PDF.
HCPSS now lists June 9–11 and June 14–16 as possible weather make-up days, so the final school week may change if emergency closures occur.

comparisonSummary: See how HCPSS dates compare with nearby Maryland school districts. The table separates published break closures from end-of-year make-up rules so the rows use the same comparison basis.

comparisonInsights.label: Start date comparison
items: HCPSS begins K–12 classes on August 24. AACPS also begins its staggered opening on August 24, with grades 1–12 in session on August 25.
HCPSS begins seven days before BCPS.
HCPSS begins one day before MCPS.

comparisonInsights.label: End-of-year rules
items: End-of-year rules are not directly comparable because districts handle weather make-up days differently.
The table shows each district’s published base date and make-up-day policy.

comparisonInsights.label: Winter break comparison
items: All four districts list winter break closures from December 24, 2026, through January 1, 2027.
Classes resume Monday, January 4, 2027, in all four districts.

values.anne-arundel-county-school-calendar: Up to three unused built-in days are deducted from the June closing date
